scenarios.title: Establish payment authority in two confirmed steps
scenarios.given: get_status reports that the buyer account has no payment authority and the user asks to set up billing.
expect: The agent asks for confirmation, then calls request_payment_authority and keeps the returned single-use confirmation token.
The agent calls confirm_payment_authority with that token and gives the hosted card-capture link only to the organization cardholder.
The agent reads the result with get({ kind: 'billing', accountId }), naming the account on every call, and never asks for card data in chat or in a tool call.

scenarios.title: Ask an administrator to approve a payment terms choice
scenarios.given: The user chooses net 45 payment terms, and the organization has not chosen them before.
expect: The agent calls save_billing with { paymentTerms } sent alone, and shows the user the approval link from the approval_required answer.
The agent says nothing changes until a direct administrator approves on our site, and never says the terms are saved before a repeat call with the returned idempotencyKey answers payment_terms_saved.

To check on the request, the agent repeats the call with that idempotencyKey, or reads pendingApprovals in get({ kind: 'billing', accountId }) when it no longer has the key, and never sends the keyless call again unless the user wants to ask again.
When the approval reads as rejected, expired or failed, the agent tells the user the request is over and asks before sending a new one.

scenarios.title: Ask an administrator to approve a renewal change
scenarios.given: The user wants the current plan to end at the end of its term, and get({ kind: 'billing', accountId }) allows that renewal change.
expect: The agent reads renewal.allowedActions, renewal.version and the deadline, asks for a reason of at least three characters, and confirms the change before calling save_billing with { renewal: { renewalVersion, action, reason } } sent alone.
The agent shows the approval link from the approval_required answer and says nothing changes until a direct administrator approves on our site.
The agent never says the renewal changed before a repeat call with the returned idempotencyKey answers renewal_changed, and never sends the keyless call again unless the user wants to ask again.
